criteria.requirement: add a sphere named `gazeTarget` directly to `app.scene`, using `SphereGeometry(0.15, 16, 8)`
criteria.action: Load the demo and inspect the live scene graph and target geometry parameters.
criteria.expected: gazeTarget is a direct scene child with radius 0.15, 16 width segments, and 8 height segments; gazePath is a closed LineLoop containing the four specified waypoints. (Tolerance: Positions within 1e-6 world units; exact object names and segment counts.)

criteria.requirement: For finite time t, compute u=((t % 12)+12)%12, i=floor(u/3), f=(u-3*i)/3
criteria.action: Enable manual mode and seek to 0, 1.5, 4.5, 7.5, 10.5, and -1.5 seconds.
criteria.expected: Positions are respectively (2,2,4), (0,2,4), (-2,2,0), (0,2,-4), (2,2,0), and (2,2,0); getState reports normalized tour times, with tourTime 10.5 for seekTour(-1.5). (Tolerance: 1e-6 per coordinate and tour time.)

criteria.requirement: Both stepping methods require manual mode and finite dt>=0; otherwise throw `RangeError`.
criteria.action: Call stepping outside manual mode and with NaN, Infinity, and negative dt; also call seekTour with non-finite values.
criteria.expected: Every invalid call throws RangeError and leaves tour time, target transform, and joint quaternions unchanged. (Tolerance: Exact error type; state equality within 1e-8.)

criteria.requirement: `seekTour(0)` followed by 600 calls to `stepLook(1/60)` must produce gazeError()<0.001 radians
criteria.action: Enable look and manual mode, seek to zero, synchronously perform 600 fixed look steps, and evaluate the exposed angular error.
criteria.expected: The effector converges toward the stationary target with gazeError below 0.001 radians and all joint quaternions remain finite. (Tolerance: Angular threshold 0.001 radians; finite numeric state required.)

criteria.requirement: A seek alone must not change any head, eye, or avatar-root quaternion.
criteria.action: Record head, both eye, and avatar-root quaternions, seek to several tour times without stepping, then compare them.
criteria.expected: Only target position and tour state change; every recorded quaternion remains unchanged. (Tolerance: 1e-8 per quaternion component.)

criteria.requirement: R sets tour time to 0 and resumes the tour; it must not change look-enabled state, camera, avatar transforms, audio, blink state, or mixer state.
criteria.action: Alter tour and pause state, then press R with look both enabled and disabled while snapshotting the protected state.
criteria.expected: Tour time becomes 0, running becomes true, target becomes p0, and every protected state remains unchanged; P subsequently toggles only running. (Tolerance: Exact booleans; numeric protected state within 1e-8.)

criteria.requirement: Keep the current avatar, idle mixer, blinking, audio/S-key speech, OrbitControls, and Spacebar look toggle working.
criteria.action: Exercise Space, mouse orbit, S, and ordinary animation frames after installing the tour.
criteria.expected: Space still enters blend-back, camera orbit remains functional, speech restarts, and idle/blink/talk ticks remain registered without duplicate look tickers. (Tolerance: No uncaught errors; exactly one active look or blend-back ticker.)

scenarios.instruction: Inspect the initial rendered 3D scene and its declared state. Inspect task-relevant depth and geometry across at least three views where appropriate, and inspect composition, materials, lighting, color, and legibility.
Exercise the central interaction and numeric or geometry contract through the visible UI. Verify meaningful scene/state feedback without inventing unrequested controls.
Repeat the boundary, invalid-input, recovery, and reset sequence while inspecting live scene state.
Inspect 1440x900 and 390x844 layouts, including lower controls and keyboard focus. Reload and inspect console/resource diagnostics.
